name: Robert Johansson
summary: Robert 'Bob' Johansson is a software engineer who sold his company, InterGator Software, and signed up with CryoEterna to have his head preserved. He was killed by a car in Las Vegas in 2016 during a science-fiction convention.

name: Andrea
summary: Andrea is one of Robert Johansson's sisters. Julia Hendricks is descended from her.
notes: Surname not confirmed in sources; listed only as 'Andrea'.

name: Dr. Landers
summary: Dr. Landers is program director for Applied Synergetics' Project HEAVEN. He revives Bob as a replicant in 2133 and is frank with him about the FAITH theocracy.
notes: Bob later learns that Landers died when the Newhaven facility was bombed by Brazilian forces.

name: Dr. Doucette
summary: Dr. Doucette is Dr. Landers' assistant on Project HEAVEN, who works with Bob when Landers is unavailable.

name: Senior Minister Travis
summary: Travis is a FAITH Ministry of Truth official who makes a surprise visit to interview the replicant candidates.

name: GUPPI
summary: GUPPI (General Unit Primary Peripheral Interface) is the AMI interface between Bob and his ship's systems. Bob gives its VR avatar the look of Admiral Ackbar.
notes: Every Bob has his own GUPPI.

name: Jeeves
summary: Jeeves is a silent VR butler, modeled on John Cleese, who serves coffee and snacks in many Bobs' VR. He is not an AMI.

name: Lucy
summary: Lucy is Milo's pet VR dog.

name: Major Ernesto Medeiros
summary: Medeiros is the Brazilian Empire's replicant probe commander. A copy follows Bob to Epsilon Eridani and is defeated there in 2144, and other copies hold Alpha Centauri and 82 Eridani.
book2Notes: Loki's second strike defeats the Medeiros presence at 82 Eridani (Nov 2195).
notes: His ship at Epsilon Eridani is the Serra do Mar.

name: Capt. Matias Araujo
summary: Araujo is the Brazilian replicant whose clones Riker and Homer fight at Sol in 2157 while they try to drop asteroids on Earth.
notes: The fight is confirmed in book 1 (ch. 21 and 24). That he is named in book 1 is not confirmed; the wiki's book-appearance table leaves it blank.

name: Henry Roberts
summary: Henry Roberts is a sailor replicated to control Australia's probe. Decades of isolation drive him half mad, and Linus finds him at Epsilon Indi in 2165 and nurses him back to health.
book2Notes: He is introduced to the Bobs at a moot (Jun 2185).

name: Col. George Butterworth
summary: Colonel George Butterworth commands what is left of the United States of Eurasia (USE) after the war. He is the first human to contact Riker and Homer (2157).
book2Notes: He is the USE's ambassador to the new UN and moves to Vulcan with the USE colony.
He has retired by 2198.
He agrees to be replicated after he dies (2211).

name: Minister Cranston
summary: Cranston represents the FAITH enclave at the post-war UN. He sees Riker as FAITH property and tries to manipulate him (2158).
book2Notes: The FAITH colony has removed him from power by 2198.

name: Julia Hendricks
summary: Julia is a descendant of Bob's sister Andrea, living in the FAITH enclave. Cranston introduces her to Riker (Nov 2158).
book2Notes: Riker grows close to her family, who call him 'Will'.
She is revived on Romulus with the extended family (Oct 2189).

name: Vickers
summary: Vickers is the Australian Federation scientist who invented the technology for replicating a mind. He leads the VEHEMENT campaign against the Bobs.
book2Notes: Riker kills him and destroys his New Zealand base (Mar 2178).

name: Dr. Bridget Sheehy
summary: Bridget Sheehy is an Irish biologist with the USE colony on Vulcan. She becomes close to Howard (2189 onward).
book2Notes: She marries Stéphane Brodeur (Apr 2195).
She refuses replication (2211).
Howard meets her through a refined android (2216).
notes: The wiki's Major Characters table marks her in book 1, but the timeline introduces her in book 2, ch. 25.

name: Stéphane Brodeur
summary: Stéphane Brodeur is the French-Canadian security chief of Landing on Vulcan and works with Howard against the local fauna.
book2Notes: He marries Bridget (Apr 2195), declines replication, and dies; Howard attends the funeral in an android body (Jan 2211).
notes: Spelled 'Stephan' on the wiki page and 'Stéphane' in the timeline.

name: Howie Brodeur
summary: Howie (Howard Brodeur) is Bridget and Stéphane's son, named after Howard and born by 2198.

name: Archimedes
summary: Archimedes is an unusually curious and inventive young Deltan whom Bob names after the Greek inventor. He becomes Bob's friend and the first alien to make contact with a (former) human.
book2Notes: He mates with Diana.
He helps found Caerleon (2182) and becomes a grandfather (2195).
Bob visits him in a Deltan android (2213).
notes: His death happens after book 2 and is left out.

name: Moses
summary: Moses is an elder of Archimedes' tribe and the only one who remembers how to work flint.

name: Arnold
summary: Arnold is a big, tactically sharp Deltan, the first to kill a gorilloid with Archimedes' hand axe. Bob's translator gives him an Austrian accent.

name: Diana
summary: Diana is a Deltan female introduced as a potential mate for Archimedes (Jun 2166). She is wary of 'the Bob'.
book2Notes: She becomes Archimedes' mate.
Her funeral is in Nov 2220.

name: Cruella
summary: Cruella is a Deltan medicine woman who often clashes with Bob.
notes: The wiki marks her in books 1 and 2; the chapter isn't confirmed.

name: Buster
summary: Buster is Archimedes' son and a skilled warrior.
book2Notes: He takes a mate (Jan 2180).

name: Hazjiar
summary: Hazjiar is a Pav town council member, one of eight Pav woken after the evacuation to choose their future.
book2Notes: She and the others choose to resettle at HIP 84051 (Apr 2221).
notes: The timeline places this in book 2, ch. 77 and says Bill wakes her; her character page says Jacques. The wiki's Major Characters table marks her in book 3 only.

name: Bullwinkle
summary: Bullwinkle is the Bobs' first android prototype, a moose-like quadruped that Bill tests (Jun 2185).

name: Rocky
summary: Rocky is Garfield's flying-squirrel-like flying android (Mar 2189).

name: Manny
summary: Manny is the first humanoid, mannequin-like android. Howard uses it to attend Stéphane's funeral (Jan 2211).
notes: 'Manny' later becomes the word for any humanoid android.

name: FAITH
summary: FAITH (Free American Independent Theocratic Hegemony) is the theocracy that has ruled most of North America since a 2041 coup. It owns Bob as property and runs Project HEAVEN.
book2Notes: Its enclave colonizes Romulus.

name: Project HEAVEN
summary: Project HEAVEN (Habitable Earths Abiogenic Vessel Exploration Network) is FAITH's von Neumann probe programme. Applied Synergetics' replicant approach wins it, and Bob is chosen from five candidates.

name: United States of Eurasia
summary: The USE governs Europe and western Russia and runs a rival probe programme. After the war its remnant, led by Butterworth, works with Riker and gets the first colony ships.
book2Notes: Its colonists settle Vulcan, founding Landing.

name: Brazilian Empire
summary: The Brazilian Empire is an Earth power that sends combat-ready replicant probes (Medeiros, Araujo) to hunt down other nations' probes.
notes: The wiki has no separate page for it.

name: VEHEMENT
summary: VEHEMENT (Voluntary Extinction of Human Existence Means Earth's Natural Transformation) is a terrorist group working for human extinction. Riker first hears of it in Nov 2158.
book2Notes: It attacks the farm donuts.
It hacks Homer (2175).
Riker destroys it (2178).
